description: Give a teammate access to a campaign by email address — including while it is still running. They see the same live run from their own AI client or the website, can abort it, answer its approval prompts, and take the next turn. They must already have a Campaign Pack account; sharing does not create one.

email.description: Email address of the person to let in. They must already have a Campaign Pack account under this address; sharing does not create one or send an invitation.

session_id.description: Campaign to act on — the session id from start_campaign or check_campaign.

name: share_campaign
title: Share a campaign
